result.title: Shift-Reliance Alignment: Ranking Vision-Language Models by the Cues They Trust
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are usually chosen from leaderboards, which give one ranking for every application. On questions about objects that a scene suggests but does not contain, however, the model with the lowest error on the POPE hallucination benchmark is not the one with the lowest error on such questions. For yes/no questions about object presence, we show that the best model for a target domain can be predicted without running any candidate on that domain, given 650 to 1,200 labeled target items that calibrate a detector. We measure each model's reliance on a cue, a feature such as scene context or text in the image, by editing 100 labeled source images so that the cue suggests the wrong answer, and comparing with a matched control edit. Reliance predicts which VLMs are misled by physical sticker attacks (Spearman .93 on nine models not used to design the score) and which hallucinate on unedited COCO photographs, beyond what their tendency to answer yes explains. Shift-Reliance Alignment (SRA) scores a model by its source error on the labeled source questions plus its reliance multiplied by the shift. The shift is the proportion of target questions on which the cue misleads, and a detector estimates it on the unlabeled target images. SRA selects the model with the lowest score. In pre-registered tests on new images where most questions mislead, it lowered the error of the selected model from 30.4% under selection by source error to 18.8% on Objects365 and OpenImages but, against its prediction, not on COCO. On CueDial, a benchmark we release that varies how often a cue misleads, selection by model confidence falls more than 40 percentage points behind the best model when overlaid text denies a visible object, and SRA stays within 3 points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何预测 VLM 在目标域的物体存在判断题上的错误：通过编辑源图测量模型对场景上下文、图中文字等线索的依赖度（reliance），再结合检测器估计的目标域 shift，提出 Shift-Reliance Alignment 评分来选择模型，并发布 CueDial 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「线索依赖 vs 视觉证据」的编辑式度量与幻觉诊断，直接关联语言先验旁路视觉证据的问题，可供核查该依赖度量能否迁移到 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与内部状态使用程度的判断，以及其模型选择视角对推理成本与收益权衡的启发。
